name: Backed IB01 Treasury Bond 0-1yr
oneLiner: bIB01 is Backed's NAV-accreting tracker token for the BlackRock iShares 0-1 year U.S. Treasury Bond UCITS ETF, KYC-gated under Swiss DLT Act framework.
collateral: Tracker certificate fully backed by the BlackRock iShares $ Treasury Bond 0-1yr UCITS ETF (IB01), held in segregated custody and administered by Backed Assets (Jersey) Limited under Swiss DLT Act framework
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting tracker token (not pegged to $1); price reflects the underlying iShares 0-1yr T-bill ETF NAV with continuous yield accrual; KYC-gated 1:1 primary mint and redemption via Backed; secondary liquidity on Uniswap and CoW Protocol

proofOfReserves.provider: Chainlink Proof of Reserve feed (reserve data sourced by The Network Firm LLP from Backed's custody-bank balances; LedgerLens non-attest service)

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Backed announced Chainlink CCIP as its interoperability infrastructure for moving Backed tokens across blockchains. bIB01 is therefore reviewed as a CCIP-backed external validated-network route rather than pure issuer-only settlement.

jurisdiction.license: Swiss DLT Act registered uncertificated securities

applicabilityBasis.summary: bIB01 is a tracker certificate (a security) referencing the BlackRock iShares $ Treasury Bond 0-1yr UCITS ETF, issued by Backed Assets (JE) Limited (Jersey). GENIUS Act §2(22)(B) (12 U.S.C. §5901(22)(B)) excludes from the payment-stablecoin definition any asset that meets the definition of a security under federal securities laws. Additionally, Backed does not offer or sell to US persons.

genius.licensingRegulator: Swiss DLT Act registered uncertificated securities framework
genius.notes: bIB01 is outside GENIUS payment-stablecoin scope: (1) it is a tracker certificate/security referencing an ETF, not a payment instrument designed for a fixed amount of monetary value (GENIUS Act §2(22)(B) excludes securities from the definition), and (2) Backed Assets (JE) Limited does not offer or sell to US persons. Issuer domicile is Jersey (Channel Islands); the Swiss DLT Act provides the structural framework for token issuance but does not change the Jersey corporate domicile.

notices.title: PoR on Polygon, supply on Ethereum
notices.message: Backed's Chainlink LedgerLens Proof-of-Reserve feed for bIB01 is published on Polygon, while Pharos reads the primary supply contract on Ethereum. Both reads are valid and refer to the same underlying Backed fund.

mintAuthority.summary: bIB01 is a NAV-accreting tracker token issued by Backed Assets (Jersey) Limited under the Swiss DLT Act; primary mint/redemption is KYC-gated 1:1 via Backed. On Ethereum (primary), the token owner and proxy admin are both controlled by the same Backed-operated Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 (2-of-3 EOA multisig, no modules, no guard) as bC3M. The same token address is deployed natively on six additional chains.

controls.label: Backed Assets issuance / transfer-agent authority
controls.evidence: Backed Assets mints bIB01 against custodied iShares IB01 ETF holdings via KYC-gated primary issuance and retains transfer-agent freeze/burn authority over balances; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.
